text.description_html:
Field Enterprises FEI-S-296-US26 Square Modern Door Stop 2-1/4" x 1-1/4"

Constructed of solid brass, this square modern floor mount door stop adds a touch of sophistication to any room. It is equally suited for use in private residential or commercial applications.

The floor mount design provides excellent protection for your walls and door hardware.

Also available: Shorter 1" Square Modern Door Stop

Only one hole to drill makes installation fast and easy. Packaged with mounting hardware that includes screw and plastic anchor for tile mount applications.

Specifications of Field Enterprises FEI-S-296 Square Modern Floor Mount Door Stop

  • Base Diameter: 1-1/4" Square
  • Floor to Bumper Height: 2-1/4"
  • Overall Height: 2-3/4"
  • Bumper Ring: Black Rubber
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Mounting Hardware: #12 x 1-1/2" screw

*Sold Individually

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.
